name: What is the difference between cabinet refacing and refinishing?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between cabinet refacing and refinishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet refinishing involves stripping the existing finish, repairing any damage, and then applying a new stain or paint directly to the cabinet doors and frames. Refacing, on the other hand, means replacing the cabinet doors and drawer fronts entirely while keeping the existing cabinet boxes. Refinishing is often a more cost-effective option for cabinets with sound structure but outdated appearance, especially if you're looking to refresh your kitchen in areas like Berkeley or Oakland without a full remodel.
acceptedAnswer.description: Refinishing updates existing cabinet surfaces with new paint or stain, while refacing replaces cabinet doors and drawer fronts entirely.
